$schema_note: This file is a design brief + exact data model for redesigning the admin settings UI of a WordPress plugin. UI copy is Persian (RTL); keys, field names and instructions are English.

project.name: Ardal (اردال)
project.type: WordPress plugin — Elementor widgets + WooCommerce store toolkit for Persian (Iranian) shops
project.screen: wp-admin → menu «اردال» → page slug "ardal-settings" (top-level menu, dashicons-art)
project.audience: Iranian shop owners and site builders (non-developers mostly), Persian UI, RTL.

task.goal: Redesign the plugin settings screen into a modern, calm, well-organized admin experience. Keep every setting and its exact field name; improve layout, hierarchy, navigation, grouping, states and micro-interactions.
deliverables: High-fidelity design of the settings shell (header, tab/side navigation, sticky save bar, search) — desktop 1440 and narrow admin (≤782px).
One full screen per tab: palette, account, wishlist, wallet — showing every card and field listed in information_architecture.

Component sheet: toggle, text, number, money input, textarea, select, icon select with preview, color picker, preset picker, image picker, sortable menu table, collapsible SMS event row with token chips, status banner, reference table with copy, unsaved-changes bar, toast.
States: default, focus, disabled/hidden-by-dependency, error, saved, unsaved changes, loading (SMS test), success/failure of SMS test.
Optional: an HTML/CSS prototype that uses the exact `name` attributes so it can be wired into the existing options.php form.

hard_constraints: Direction RTL, language Persian. Persian digits for display. Suggested font: Vazirmatn (or Yekan Bakh); must look native next to wp-admin chrome (WP admin sidebar stays on the right in RTL).

All tabs are ONE <form method="post" action="options.php"> with settings_fields("ardal_settings_group"); one save submits all four options (ardal_palette, ardal_account, ardal_wishlist, ardal_wallet). Never split into separate forms.
Every field keeps its `name` exactly as given. Toggles/checkboxes post value "1" when on and nothing when off.
Hidden-by-dependency fields (show_when) must stay in the DOM (hide visually, still submitted).
A field key must appear only once in the form (duplicate names silently override each other).
Accessible: real <label for>, visible focus, keyboard-operable tabs/toggles/accordions, contrast AA.
No external CDN assets in the final product except fonts if bundled; wp-color-picker and wp.media (media library) are available.
current_ui_pain_points: Very long single-column pages; account tab alone has 9 cards and ~45 fields with no way to jump or search.
Tabs are plain buttons; no indication of which tab has unsaved changes; save button only at bottom of each tab.
Help text under every field is long and always visible — visual noise.
SMS card repeats 4 fields × 5 events in one flat list.
Dangerous WooCommerce asset toggles look identical to harmless options.
Live preview exists only for the palette; other tabs give no visual feedback.
Widget list in sidebar is a plain long numbered list.
Support phone/hours live in the palette tab though they belong to the account panel.
improvement_ideas: Left-side (RTL: right-side) section navigation with sub-anchors per card; sticky header with search across labels.
Sticky bottom save bar that appears when anything changes ("تغییرات ذخیره نشده" + ذخیره + بازگردانی).
Collapse help text into an info icon/tooltip or show on focus; keep short label + one-line hint.
Group card master switch (e.g. «این باکس نمایش داده شود») in the card header; dim/collapse the card body when off.
Mark advanced/risky fields (risk: advanced) in a separate «پیشرفته» area with warning styling.
Palette tab: big live preview panel (already exists: topbar, hero, product card, deal countdown, footer) + preset cards with swatches + reset to design.
Wallet tab: show a small summary strip (enabled features) and a link-card to «گزارش کیف پول».
Drag & drop menu rows that write into the hidden order inputs.
Token chips ({name} {amount} …) that insert into the focused input/textarea.

brand.note: The admin UI may use a neutral modern look with Ardal accent; current front-end design tokens below (defaults, user-changeable).

field_types.icon_select: select of icon keys with live SVG preview
field_types.color: hex color with picker + reset to default

information_architecture.title: پالت و ظاهر
information_architecture.lede: رنگ‌های زیر روی همه ویجت‌های اردال در المنتور اعمال می‌شوند. با تغییر هر رنگ، پیش‌نمایش کنار صفحه بلافاصله به‌روز می‌شود.

aside.live_preview: نمونهٔ زنده: نوار اعلان، هیرو با دکمه، کارت محصول (تخفیف، ستاره، قیمت خط‌خورده، قیمت با «تومان» یا نماد تومان، دکمهٔ +)، باکس پیشنهاد ویژه با شمارش معکوس و نوار پیشرفت، فوتر. همه با متغیرهای CSS --ard-*.

widget_list.title: کیف پول — کارت موجودی و شارژ

related_screen_optional.title: گزارش کیف پول (submenu under اردال, capability manage_woocommerce)
sections: درخواست‌های برداشت: فیلتر وضعیت (همه/در انتظار/پرداخت شد/رد شد/لغو شد)، جدول (شماره، کاربر و موجودی، مبلغ، شبا و صاحب حساب، تاریخ، وضعیت، فرم بررسی با کد پیگیری/دلیل رد و دکمه‌های «پرداخت شد»/«رد»)، صفحه‌بندی؛ نشان تعداد در منو.
فیلترها: بازهٔ زمانی، نوع تراکنش، وضعیت، کاربر، مبلغ.
کارت‌های خلاصه، نمودار روزانه، تفکیک بر اساس نوع، کاربران فعال، جدول تراکنش‌ها با مرتب‌سازی و خروجی CSV.
ابزارها: تغییر موجودی یک کاربر، شارژ گروهی با پیش‌نمایش و تأیید، ثبت کش‌بگ سفارش‌های گذشته.
